source: The edges of the filters nilgai labels a measurement with, each as its paper writes it and cited. They are not the colour profiles in profiles.json, which only set what a band looks like: a catalogue's own filter lives here. approximate is true while the edges are rounded from memory of the paper and not yet read from it.

filters.name: W1
filters.band: WISE W1 alone, about 2.8 to 3.9 um; edges approximate until read from the relative response curves of Wright et al. 2010, AJ 140, 1868. Read the way W2 to W4 are (10% of peak, RSR-W1.EE.txt of the Explanatory Supplement) the edges would be 2.80 to 3.82 um; they are not changed here

filters.name: W2
filters.band: WISE W2 alone: the wavelengths where its energy-based relative system response first and last reaches 10% of its peak, 4.04 to 5.26 um, read from RSR-W2.EE.txt at the file's 0.01 um steps. The 10% level is picked, as no source gives edges: at 1% the range is 3.97 to 5.34 um and at half the peak it is 4.10 to 5.19 um
filters.cite: WISE All-Sky Release Explanatory Supplement, section IV.4.h(v), whose RSR-W2.EE.txt is the response of Jarrett et al. 2011, ApJ 735, 112; saved copy in nilgai-data/wise-docs/figures/

filters.name: W3
filters.band: WISE W3 alone: where its energy-based relative system response first and last reaches 10% of its peak, 7.54 to 16.74 um, read from RSR-W3.EE.txt. The 10% level is picked, as no source gives edges: at 1% the range is 7.45 to 17.26 um and at half the peak it is 10.08 to 16.35 um
filters.cite: WISE All-Sky Release Explanatory Supplement, section IV.4.h(v), whose RSR-W3.EE.txt is the response of Jarrett et al. 2011, ApJ 735, 112; saved copy in nilgai-data/wise-docs/figures/

filters.name: W4
filters.band: WISE W4 alone: where its energy-based relative system response first and last reaches 10% of its peak, 19.70 to 26.79 um, read from RSR-W4.EE.txt. The 10% level is picked, as no source gives edges: at 1% the range is 19.53 to 27.91 um and at half the peak it is 19.86 to 24.59 um
filters.cite: WISE All-Sky Release Explanatory Supplement, section IV.4.h(v), whose RSR-W4.EE.txt is the response of Jarrett et al. 2011, ApJ 735, 112; saved copy in nilgai-data/wise-docs/figures/

filters.name: Energy_Flux100
filters.band: 4FGL's Energy_Flux100 column, the energy flux from 100 MeV to 100 GeV, as 4FGL defines it; not the whole catalogue's range
filters.cite: Abdollahi et al. 2022, ApJS 260, 53, for the column definitions; the release is 4FGL-DR4, Ballet et al. 2023, arXiv 2307.12546
